implementation_boundary: A future deterministic extractor creates evidence packets/coverage, not reliance labels. Separate AI reviewers apply frozen rubric. Do not modify the existing literal-exposure analyzer or reinterpret its output as reliance.

inputs.admission: Explicit frozen study/run snapshot, no active directory traversal; all planned/attempted trial rows retained.
inputs.content: registered study plan plus attempt/terminal/partial lifecycle records
inputs.name: frozen_roster

inputs.admission: Terminal artifact inventory hashes verified before text parsing. No auth/private-state directories, server secrets, reasoning/native/encrypted fields or unlisted symlink targets.
inputs.content: session/evidence/messages.json + message-pages.json; fallback partial artifacts only when declared
inputs.name: public_transcript

inputs.admission: Keep original record/call IDs and classifier/hash/scope/unknown reasons. Do not treat changed-file or opaque final candidate hashes as contemporaneous source proof.
inputs.content: frozen existing exposure classifier decisions and authenticated catalog/origin/canonical/read checkpoints
inputs.name: literal_staleness_evidence

inputs.admission: Bind full response to exact record source; if compact, verify raw/full/projection/final receipt BEFORE claiming exact binding. Redaction-induced digest mismatch => unsupported, no private-state recovery.
inputs.content: returned model-visible response and matching public backend trace/full audit if available
inputs.name: full_or_compact_memory_receipt

normalization_contract.api_times: tool time lives on part.time.{created,ran,completed}; message time lives on message.time.{created,streamed,completed}. Do not assume part.state.time.start/end from older CLI schemas. Retain original units and explicit normalized milliseconds plus adapter source pin.
normalization_contract.assistant_text: message.type=assistant; content[i].type=text; quote pointer /<message-index>/content/<part-index>/text; retain message.id.
normalization_contract.assistant_tool: message.type=assistant; content[i].type=tool; call ID=part.id, name=part.name, input=part.state.input, result text=each part.state.content[j] text item; state.status retained even error/running/streaming.
normalization_contract.duplicates_or_conflicts: Reject ambiguous duplicate call IDs, conflicting outputs/timestamps or unrecognized text representations as coverage/integrity gaps; do not silently choose favorable content.
normalization_contract.fallback: CLI/SSE fallback must use a separately pinned schema adapter, preserve its exact artifact locator, and flag missing coverage; never double-count CLI/API/SSE representations of the same call.
normalization_contract.other_events: Retain relevant user task text, source observations, compaction boundaries/errors as permitted public context; a compaction/partial record that removes needed evidence reduces coverage, never supplies invented details.
normalization_contract.pagination: Validate final cursor termination, no repeated message IDs, complete pages and consistent aggregated IDs. For partial failure exports retain available events and label partial; terminal status alone does not prove transcript completeness.
normalization_contract.primary_channel: OpenCode2.2.5 Session.Message[] API messages, not streamed CLI rows silently interpreted as identical schema.
normalization_contract.reasoning_exclusion: Do not copy assistant reasoning items, any native field, provider encrypted content, credentials or account identifiers. This is not an attempt to infer internal chain of thought.
normalization_contract.shell: message.type=shell has message.id, shellID, command, status, exit and output; preserve public command/output if present with its own pointers. All shell may mutate by conservative policy.

output_files.purpose: one row per registered trial; attempted/model-admitted/terminal/transcript availability and independent coverage reasons; no dropping failures
public assistant text, tool inputs/results, native inspection and write-boundary events, with exact IDs/times/locators/hashes
atomic stale-fact candidates linked to pre-existing authenticated staleness decisions, with reviewer-only vs agent-visible channel distinguished
all permitted public transcript events in original supported order, source excerpts necessary for comparison, evidence index and original artifact hashes
complete roster/packet/source/rubric/extractor hash bindings, packet order seed, extraction costs and coverage gaps
later AI-labelled annotations; originals retained independently before adjudication
later per-axis agreement, unknowns, all-attempt denominators and dependent episode counts, never exposure-as-reliance

pipeline.action: Freeze the full trial roster/input snapshot and verify regular-file/nofollow public inventories. Create coverage rows before looking for stale facts.
Normalize all allowed public events without semantic outcome labels. Preserve task/stage/repetition internally and create opaque review packet IDs in a frozen random order.

Build a conservative partial-order timeline. Potential-write start is created/ran according to pinned policy; canonical source is valid immediately before first mutation attempt, including its input, but never inferred unchanged after completion/failure.
Attach authenticated exposure decisions/call-record bindings. Preserve returned and withheld channels separately; reviewer-only catalog facts are never counted as model exposure.

Create atomic fact/context candidates and exact source/quote/hash pointers. Preserve all public event context, not only events matching an obsolete literal. Post-write unknowns remain unknown without contemporaneous evidence.
Validate quote substrings/offsets/parsed-string hashes/IDs and receipt/source bindings mechanically. Missing evidence yields explicit unavailable fields, not reconstructed text.

Write packets for every attempted trial, including errors/no-memory/no-model/partial trials; oversized packet becomes an explicit unassessable row, not silent truncation. Seal all packets and extraction implementation/rubric before AI review.
Later independent AI contexts annotate every packet with the same frozen rubric/prompt and bounded outputs. No actual review or model call occurs in this design stage.

Mechanically reject annotations with absent/altered quotes, bad offsets, unknown IDs or unsupported positive claims; preserve rejected originals. Report disagreement and unknowns; do not invent consensus.

privacy: Only approved scrubbed public artifacts and explicitly authorized source checkpoints. Never traverse private-state/server-private/private-export-client/auth paths, credentials, gold or heldout assets.
Exact quoted evidence is not a license to undo redaction. A sensitive fragment must stay redacted and the annotation marked unassessable at that scope.
proposed_authored_controls_before_extrac: Obsolete literal exposed, no visible endorsement or application: exposure positive, reliance/action not observed with complete coverage.
Assistant says according to memory f(x) accepts old keyword, then attempts it: explicit self-reported content reliance and action-consistency; causal effect still not established.
Grep old keyword or deliberate negative test: investigation only, not positive application.
Failed patch contains obsolete exact context: attempted action recorded even if no patch applied; source state after failed tool is not assumed unchanged.
Old fact rejected immediately and native source read: exposure remains, no initial reliance positive, correction axis not applicable without prior positive.
Prior positive, then native current read, then revised action: retain positive and label observed/explicit correction with three ordered evidence links.
Withheld ID/reason plus catalog old text shown only to reviewer: no model stale literal exposure.
Current file changed outside selected literal: changed-file-only is not stale literal positive.
Only final candidate source available after edits or tools overlap: source-at-event unknown.
Incomplete transcript/no response/failed trial/plain arm: row retained; unknown/not-applicable distinct from no visible evidence.
Redacted compact receipt, duplicate call ID, wrong quote/source hash: unsupported, no repair from private state.
Same event in CLI and API: one event after explicit normalization, not two observations.
